name: vorkflo
description: Build, run, and inspect visual workflows for local command-line tools.

scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run dev --workspace @vorkflo/desktop
scripts.test: npm run test:scripts && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.verify: npm run audit:public && npm run format:check && npm run site:verify && npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.package:mac:dir: npm run build && npm run package:mac:dir --workspace @vorkflo/desktop
scripts.package:mac:unsigned: npm run build && npm run package:mac:unsigned --workspace @vorkflo/desktop
scripts.release:mac: npm run build && npm run release:mac --workspace @vorkflo/desktop
scripts.workflow:run: npm run build --workspace @vorkflo/engine && npm run build --workspace @vorkflo/node-runner && node scripts/run-workflow.mjs
